procedure.method: Fresh independent portfolio review in this session. Read the exact pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, compact addendum/README and adapter, source manifest and five preservation manifests; verified pinned file hashes and PNG dimensions without following their unlisted paths. The packet declares no protected layouts, so protected_layouts_read is explicitly empty. Actually opened the exact source PNG with tools.view_image(detail=original) and emitted it at original detail. Then actually opened and visually inspected M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M2 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M3 native/usage720/thumbnail320, M4 native/usage720/thumbnail320 and M5 native/usage720/thumbnail320, each exact PNG with tools.view_image(detail=original) emitted at original detail. All fifteen poster views were completed before the first copy-reading/transcription stage, judgment, image rating or diversity rating. After that sequence, first readings were transcribed from the displayed native pixels in twelve-entry packet order per image, retaining visible soft wraps and word spaces; no OCR, replacement views, image edits or ambiguity revisits were used. No peer or unlisted producer/planner record was inspected and no critic was spawned/resumed/forked. session_id remains null because the actual runtime trace identity is not observable here. Semantic viewing is my attestation, not a claim inferred from hash validation or helper success. Native-call reference attachment is unassessable from the permitted evidence and is recorded as a limit; all definite observed quality/condition failures remain recorded.
